settings.title: 01. Scope & Eligibility
settings.body: By browsing or placing an order through VESLORIA, you confirm that you are of legal contracting age in your jurisdiction and are purchasing skincare formulations strictly for personal, non-commercial use.

settings.title: 02. Formulations, Availability & Pricing
settings.body: All formulations are presented with transparent volume specifications and listed prices in the active store currency (USD default). Prices exclude applicable destination taxes, VAT, or customs duties unless stated otherwise at Shopify Checkout.

settings.title: 03. Reserve Small-Batch Allocations
settings.body: Reserve Formulations (such as No. 01 Nocturnal Concentrate and No. 02 Restorative Balm) are produced in fixed runs of 250 numbered vessels. Inventory is strictly tracked; adding a vessel to your bag does not reserve stock until checkout completion.

settings.title: 04. Payment & Order Acceptance
settings.body: Payments are processed securely via PCI-compliant Shopify Checkout. VESLORIA reserves the right to cancel or limit quantities where fraud, reselling, or inventory discrepancy is detected.

settings.title: 05. Intellectual Property
settings.body: The VESLORIA wordmark, standalone V monogram, vessel architecture, macro photography, editorial copy, and brand toolkit materials remain the exclusive intellectual property of VESLORIA.

settings.title: 06. Governing Law & Consumer Rights
settings.body: Nothing in these terms limits mandatory statutory consumer rights under applicable US, UK, EU, or Australian consumer protection legislation.

settings.heading: TERMS & CONDITIONS
settings.intro: These Terms & Conditions govern access to the VESLORIA digital flagship, formulation orders, and Reserve small-batch allocations. Final commercial terms are subject to legal review per operating jurisdiction prior to live retail activation.
